description.policy: __TODO__ An ODRL policy: permissions, prohibitions and obligations on assets for audiences or principals.
description.audience: __TODO__ An ODRL PartyCollection: listed principals, narrowed by the refinement (all must hold). With no principals listed, the refinement selects from all principals; with neither, the audience is empty.
description.asset_collection: __TODO__ An ODRL AssetCollection: listed assets (a catalog or schema covers its children), narrowed by the refinement.
description.target: __TODO__ Where compiled policies ship: a platform, the securables it manages, and how releases may be delivered.

releases.hint: __TODO__ A release compiles all active policies for a target into concrete grants, diffs them against the Grant Ledger and ships the change through the Delivery Modes after review.

modeHint.direct: __TODO__ Apply GRANT / REVOKE now via the Databricks SDK; the ledger updates per applied item.
modeHint.indirect: __TODO__ Write the release as Ontos YAML to the Git repository for your CI to apply.
modeHint.manual: __TODO__ Notify admins with a SQL runbook to run by hand.

releases.deliverDescription: __TODO__ Choose the Delivery Modes to use. Only modes enabled in Settings → Delivery are available.
releases.noModes: __TODO__ No Delivery Mode is enabled. Enable one in Settings → Delivery.
releases.confirmDescription: __TODO__ Confirm the release was applied on the target (e.g. the Git change was merged and run, or the SQL runbook was executed). The Grant Ledger is updated accordingly.
releases.awaitingConfirmation: __TODO__ Delivered via Indirect / Manual mode. Confirm once the change was applied on the target — until then the Grant Ledger is unchanged.
releases.liveMissing: __TODO__ Desired but not granted on the platform
releases.liveStale: __TODO__ Granted by Ontos but no longer desired
releases.description: __TODO__ Compiled desired state of all active Access Policies for this target.
releases.errorsBlock: __TODO__ Errors block review — fix the policies and recompile.
releases.changesHint: __TODO__ Diff against the Grant Ledger; {{unchanged}} grants unchanged. Grants Ontos didn't apply are never revoked.
releases.gatedHint: __TODO__ These permissions need a workflow (duties, purpose) or attribute-based enforcement and are never granted unconditionally.
releases.untrackHint: __TODO__ These grants already existed on the platform before Ontos applied them. Ontos stops tracking them and does not revoke them.

ledger.hint: __TODO__ Grants Ontos applied through releases and tracks — the basis for time-bound (GDPR) revocation. Grants created outside Ontos are not listed.
ledger.impliedTitle: __TODO__ Parent privilege (USE CATALOG / USE SCHEMA) required to reach the granted object
ledger.preexistingTitle: __TODO__ Already on the platform when Ontos applied it — Ontos never revokes it

targets.hint: __TODO__ Targets decide where releases compile to. While no Unity Catalog target is active, the built-in 'uc' target covers all of Unity Catalog. Two active targets of one system may not overlap.
targets.keyHint: __TODO__ Stable identifier releases and the Grant Ledger use (e.g. uc, uc-prod). Fixed once the target has more than one version.
targets.scopeHint: __TODO__ Securable prefixes this target manages, one per line (catalog or catalog.schema). Empty = everything in the system. Narrowing the scope stops tracking grants outside it; they are never revoked.
targets.deliveryModesHint: __TODO__ None selected = any mode enabled in Settings.
targets.scheduleHint: __TODO__ Cron expression (Quartz or 5-field). Drift is reported, never auto-fixed.
targets.semantics: __TODO__ Releases for this target compile only the securables in its scope and ship through its allowed delivery modes.
